viewing_check: Check the burl/eye cluster and orange heart figure on the face and back, depth of the rot seam, thickness and true length and width, and whether it is genuinely Huon pine (smell, fine pin knots) rather than celery top or similar. Figured width over about 40 cm and thickness over 50 mm would lift it towards the $150 to $200 end.
